name: ADDA Run 2026
short_description: ADDA Run 2026 is on Sunday 13 December 2026 at Siam Premium Outlets Bangkok in Bang Sao Thong, Samut Prakan, over 21 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: ADDA Run 2026 is a running event on Sunday 13 December 2026 at Siam Premium Outlets Bangkok, which the RUNLAH listing places in Bang Sao Thong, Samut Prakan. It is organised by SANSATAN Organizer for the footwear brand ADDA, and offers 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. The race-day programme starts at 3.00am; the 5 km is a walk-run with no timing.

faqs.question: How much is entry to ADDA Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The 21 km costs THB 950, the 10 km THB 700 and the 5 km THB 600. Packages that include a pair of ADDA Flow shoes cost THB 1,100, THB 850 and THB 750. Finishers of the 21 km receive a finisher shirt.

faqs.question: When and where is the ADDA Run expo?
faqs.answer: Race kit collection is on Saturday 12 December 2026 from 10.00 to 18.00 at Siam Premium Outlets Bangkok. Runners can choose postal delivery instead. The race-day programme begins at 3.00am on 13 December.
